nom: Vitamin C and Turmeric Face Scrub Cream Organics Microdermabrasion Facial Scrub Exfoliating Clears Blackheads Improve Da

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one in her 80s using it to help control whiteheads, generally report the scrub does not leave skin feeling dry or tight, with product instructions recommending dry-skin users limit use to about once a week.
segments.oily: The one reviewer who separately names an oily T-zone, alongside dry cheeks, reports smooth results, and product instructions recommend oily-skin users can use it up to twice a week.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one with a dry cheek area and an oily T-zone, report the scrub leaves their whole face smooth without over-drying the dry areas.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report the scrub does not irritate their face, including one who says it also lightens her blemishes.

concerns.spots: This is the effect most reviewers focused on report success with: dark spots, hyperpigmentation and sun damage looking visibly lighter after several weeks to a few months of regular, targeted use, with some reviewers pairing it with a broader skincare routine.
concerns.blemishes: Reports diverge: several reviewers say it calmed existing blemishes, reduced blackheads, or made a stubborn pimple shrink faster, but one reviewer says a recent jar with an off smell caused new breakouts and irritation, and another says it did nothing for her 12-year-old son's puberty breakouts and may have added bumps.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers say the scrub calmed existing redness and dullness; against this, the reviewer who got a jar with an unusual smell says it caused new redness and irritation on her face.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, across dry, oily and combination skin, report the scrub does not leave skin feeling dry or tight and instead feels moisturized afterward, consistent with packaging guidance suggesting drier skin use it about once a week and oilier skin up to twice a week.

extraits.texte: I typically use Acure brightening facial scrub but I saw this and wanted to try it. Well it been 3 months of only using in once per week. It does make my face feel every soft but I went to use it last night and as you can see in the picture there is now mold growing inside. There’s a lot still in the container and now I have to throw it out, complete waste of money will go back to Acure.

Honest Review – Mixed Experience I purchased this Vitamin C and Turmeric Face Scrub Cream three times in the past because I really liked how it worked initially and thought it was a good value. The scrub has a pleasant natural ingredient list (like turmeric, vitamin C, aloe vera, and walnut shell powder) that’s supposed to help exfoliate, brighten, and clear skin. The first couple of times I used it, it seemed fine and did what I expected without any issues. However, the most recent jar I bought had a strong, weird smell right out of the package, unlike the mild scent advertised. After using it on my face, my skin started breaking out with irritation and redness, which I’ve never experienced with previous purchases. Because of that reaction, I won’t be using this product again. It could be that I got a bad batch, or the formula has changed — but either way, it was enough of a negative experience that I won’t repurchase. Pros: • Natural-sounding ingredients • Good exfoliation when it worked • Affordable Cons: • Weird smell on most recent purchase • Caused facial irritation and breakouts for me • Inconsistent experience Wouldn’t recommend based on my latest experience.

I’ve been using this product every other day for 16 weeks now. (Last two pics are 16th week results) sorry I don’t have week 1 pics but even by week 4 there were significant results! My dark spots on my cheeks are very little Joe and that was the main goal. My process: every other day (at night for me) apply liberal amount to areas with dark spots , leave for 2-5 min, scrub/exfoliate entire face paying close attention to dark spot areas & then rinse. This has helped with dark spots! My regular skin care routine is first the cera ve Salicylic acid cleanser and then the turmeric scrub or the st Ives blackhead scrub (I alternate them each day). I then use the thayers blemish clearing toner and finish with the peach slices Snail Rescue all-in-one deep moisture cream. (This is my night routine). For the morning I do the cera ve benzoyl peroxide foaming cream for a cleanser and then use the thayers toner with a vitamin c day cream. Disclaimer: this is what has worked from me, from my aunts advise who has seen a dermatologist since she was very young! (She uses this scrub and it was her recommendation for me). I am not knowledgeable enough to give further advice :) just sharing my personal experience, hope this helps!

This thing is crack!! Just for reference I am combo skin. Dry around the cheeks, some pigmentation around the cheek area and oily in the T-zone. I have been looking for a scrub with vitamin C and the fact that it has turmeric even better.It comes with a brush but I applied it with my fingers. I applied it to my wet face and massaged it for 1 minute. A little goes on a long way. It does have micro exfoliates and goes on smooth. I washed it off after a minute and my face was smooth. I then pat dry and added my facial toner and moisturizer and my face is smooth as a baby clean bottom

extraits.titre: Does a Good Job of Exfoliating without Drying Out.
extraits.texte: I have always taken care of my very dry, pale skin and am always looking out for new products to be sure I keep up with changes as I age. I use this about 3x a week because at 81, I have an outbreak of whiteheads! This helps control them without drying out my skin. It would not work alone - I need retinol, a C serum and a moisturizer plus sunscreen, but it fits well into my regimen.

extraits.titre: It exfoliates and leaves skin feeling soft
extraits.texte: I’ve tried everything for exfoliating my face and after I tried this once I instantly fell in love. It’s helped my redness, my blackheads on my nose and has made my face so much clearer and softer! 10/10 will buy again.
